label: Overview
caption: The landing is a stock <data-dashboard>: the payload's 15 headline numbers as data-ui's own KPI cards (here and nowhere else), each joint in numbers, and the tool from above; the left rail is data-ui's stock app rail.

label: One joint
caption: Each page is a .base file swapped on the same dashboard; the Joint pick is a stock select facet that exists only on this page, and every heatmap is a Vega-Lite rect over the payload's own cells.

label: Settings gear
caption: Colormap, Reverse and scale are set once behind the gear and repaint every heatmap; data-ui has no dashboard-wide setting, so this one control is the host's (it rewrites each chart's Vega-Lite colour scale).

label: Trajectories table
caption: The stock data-ui table Zach pointed at: saved views as tabs (+ saves the current one), a filter rail (here: holdout), groups by split that fold, one-click sort.

label: Drill + Open in Rerun
caption: A row opens data-ui's side peek: that trajectory's numbers, its joint angles over time, and Open in Rerun, which asks the round server to open its .rrd.
